summary: Tested email delivery and invitation registration bug fixes. All 17 backend API tests PASSED. Frontend InviteAccept page error screens, registration form fields, and Invitations page email delivery status display all verified working.
passed_tests: Backend: test_01_validate_nonexistent_token_returns_404 - GET /api/invitations/validate/{token} returns 404 for non-existent tokens
Backend: test_02_validate_cancelled_token_returns_400 - GET /api/invitations/validate/{token} returns 400 for cancelled invitations
Backend: test_03_validate_expired_token_returns_400 - returns 400 for expired invitations
Backend: test_04_validate_used_token_shows_already_used - returns used=true for already used tokens
Backend: test_05_validate_valid_token_returns_invitation_data - returns invitation details with email, role, company_name
Backend: test_01_register_invalid_token_returns_404 - POST /api/auth/register-with-invite returns 404 for invalid tokens
Backend: test_02_register_cancelled_token_returns_400 - returns 400 for cancelled invitations
Backend: test_03_register_success_creates_user - creates user with assigned_properties and permissions from invitation
Backend: test_04_register_sets_session_cookie - sets session_token cookie after registration
Backend: test_01_login_success - POST /api/auth/login works for password-registered users
Backend: test_02_login_invalid_password - returns 401 for invalid password
Backend: test_03_login_nonexistent_user - returns 401 for non-existent user
Backend: test_01_sender_email_env_configured - SENDER_EMAIL configured in backend .env
Backend: test_02_frontend_url_env_configured - FRONTEND_URL configured for invite links
Backend: test_03_resend_api_key_configured - RESEND_API_KEY configured with production key
Backend: test_04_code_uses_onboarding_resend_for_gmail - Code uses onboarding@resend.dev for Gmail senders
Backend: test_05_code_uses_frontend_url_for_invite_link - Code uses FRONTEND_URL env var for invite links
Frontend: InviteAccept shows error screen for invalid/expired/cancelled tokens (with data-testid='invite-error')
Frontend: InviteAccept shows 'Already Registered' screen for used tokens (with data-testid='invite-already-used')
Frontend: InviteAccept registration form has first_name, last_name, phone, password, confirm_password fields
Frontend: InviteAccept shows Google and password registration options
Frontend: Invitations page shows email delivery status (sent/failed) for each invitation
Frontend: Invitations page table has status filter tabs (All, Pending, Accepted, Expired, Cancelled)
Frontend: Send Invitation dialog has role select, person select, email input, properties list

token_validation_api.details: GET /api/invitations/validate/{token} returns 404 for non-existent, 400 for cancelled/expired, 200 with used=true for already used tokens

register_with_invite_api.details: POST /api/auth/register-with-invite returns 404 for invalid tokens, 400 for cancelled, creates user with assigned_properties and permissions, sets session cookie

password_login_api.details: POST /api/auth/login works for password-registered users, returns 401 for invalid credentials

email_from_address_fix.details: Code at line 2174-2175 checks for @gmail.com/@yahoo.com/@hotmail.com and uses 'PropStack <onboarding@resend.dev>' as from address

invite_link_url_fix.details: Code at line 2107-2108 uses FRONTEND_URL env var: frontend_url = os.environ.get('FRONTEND_URL', base_url), invite_link = f'{frontend_url}/invite/{token}'

email_delivery_status_logging.details: Code at line 2188-2192 stores email_delivery_status='sent' or 'failed' and email_provider_response in DB

invite_accept_page_error_screens.details: InviteAccept.js shows: (1) Error screen with data-testid='invite-error' for invalid/expired/cancelled tokens, (2) 'Already Registered' screen with data-testid='invite-already-used' for used tokens

invite_accept_registration_form.details: Form has all fields: first_name, last_name, phone, password, confirm_password with data-testid attributes, plus Google sign-in option and terms checkbox

invitations_page_email_status.details: Invitations.js table shows email_delivery_status: 'Email delivered' (green) for sent, 'Email failed' (red) for failed - visible in Status column

test_credentials.note: Tests create isolated test data with timestamps and cleanup after completion

seed_data_creation: Tests create temporary companies, users, sessions, and invitations with timestamp prefixes for isolation
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 20 verified email delivery and invitation registration bug fixes: (1) Token validation API returns proper error codes (404 for invalid, 400 for cancelled/expired), (2) Register-with-invite API creates user with assigned_properties and permissions, (3) Password login works for registered users, (4) Email from address uses onboarding@resend.dev for Gmail senders (Resend free-tier requirement), (5) Invite links use FRONTEND_URL env var, (6) Frontend InviteAccept page has proper error screens and registration form with all fields, (7) Invitations page displays email delivery status (sent/failed) in the table. Note: The Invitations admin page route is /invitations (not /invite). All features fully working.
